eva: Hi team 12: Zenith Health asked for a fast-turn RFP response focused on our Private/on-prem offering. They specifically want a capability matrix comparing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for data residency, KMS/HSM import, latency SLOs, and mitigation for model drift. Also asked for a 30-day POC and pricing tiers for reserved capacity. Can we get a compact response by EOD tomorrow?

priya: I can own the capability matrix. I'll include rows for: data residency locales, supported KMS/HSM integrations, allowed network topologies (VPC peering, direct connect), SLA tiers, and model lifecycle controls (pinning/rollbacks).

don: I'll add a short note on model drift mitigation: prompt/eval based regression alerts, per-prompt eval sets, and the ability to pin previous model versions for rollback. Also mention Optimize recommendations (quantization, batching) for cost control.

matt: For pricing: propose reserved capacity bands (small/medium/large) with monthly commit and a per-token overage for the Hosted fallback. I'll generate a quick estimate spreadsheet.

hannah: Legal forwarded a redline asking for export-control assurance. We should avoid promising classification-level compliance. Marked the RFP response accordingly and attached a short legal note.

eva: Great. Deliverables: compact capability matrix doc in Drive (https://drive.google.com/fake/zenith-cap), pricing spreadsheet, annotated legal note, and a POC ops plan. Can we do a 20-minute sync at 3pm PT?

priya: 3pm PT works. I'll upload the matrix in table format.

don: I'll draft the model-drift bullets and attach eval sample.

matt: Uploading pricing now.

hannah: Uploaded legal note.

eva: Thanks. I'll assemble and send to buyer first thing tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:
